CustomField.label: Stream Replies
CustomField.description: Whether this agent's chats start with live streaming on: the tools it runs are narrated as they run, and the reply appears as it is written. Off by default. This is the starting point for a conversation, not a lock — anyone chatting can turn streaming on or off from the chat window, and their choice is remembered for that agent in that browser.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Start chats with this agent in streaming mode. People can still switch it off during a chat.
